text.en:
The administrative structure of the Office of the President
is hereby reorganized in consonance with the provisions of the
Administrative Code of 1987.
The provisions of Sections 21, 22, and 23, Chapter 8, Title II,
Book TIT of the Administrative Code are hereby reiterated.
The Presidential Artion Center (PACE), formerly the
Mal cañang Public Assistance Center (MPAC), shall be detached from the
Presidential Management Staff and placed under the Office of the President
The Cabinet Secretariat shall continue to be part of the
Presidential Management Staff (PMS).
The functions of the Executive Secretary prescribed by the
provisions of Chapter 9, Benk III of the Administrative Code are hereby
reiterated.
SEC. G The Executive Secretary shall cause the preparation and
approve the internal administrative structure, the staffing pattern and all
personnel movements in the Office of the President as may be necessary for
the purpose of implementing this Executive Order.

- 2 -

The Executive Secretary is hereby authorized to issue the
necessary issuances to implement this Executive Order.
All provisions of previous issuances or parts thereof which
are in conflict with this Executive Order are hereby modified and/or revoked
accordingly.
This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 30th day of September, in the year of
Our Lord, nineteen hundred and ninety-one.
By the President:
